newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: SOCCER-AUSTRALIA STRUGGLE TO BEAT TAHITI 2-0.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-AUSTRALIA STRUGGLE TO BEAT TAHITI 2-0.

text.p: Australia, who have already qualified for the Oceania playoff, completed their qualifying group with maximum points after labouring to a 2-0 win over Tahiti on Thursday.
Auxerre midfielder Ned Zelic scored Australia's opener with a fine volley in the 17th minute before South Melbourne striker Paul Trimboli sealed the victory with four minutes remaining.
But Terry Venables' side struggled to break down Tahiti's mass defence and lacked invention in a disappointing display against the south Pacific islanders at Parramatta Stadium.
As group winner, Australia face a playoff over two legs in June and July against New Zealand for the Oceania title.
The winner will play an Asian opponent later in the year for a place in next year's World Cup in France.
Australia have scored 26 goals and conceded two goals in four games in their qualifying group, which also included Solomon Islands.
Venables praised Tahiti's defensive performance and organisation.
"That's what they were here for -- to stop us. They organised themselves very well, and played very well," said Venables.
